text:
Maya (Marketing): Hey team — planning a short deliverable list for the upcoming benchmark webinar and web launch. Need a brand-compliant infographic + a system diagram that can live in the blog and the slide deck. Deadline: next Thu EOD.
Liam (Design): Got it — can you share the key metrics and copy? Also what sizes do you need?
Maya (Marketing): Main metrics: median p95 latency 85ms; cost per 1k tokens down 42%; throughput x1.8 vs baseline. Copy is rough, Arjun will paste below. Sizes: 1200x628 (social), 1600x900 (hero slide), 800x1000 (one-pager PDF). Exportable SVG + PNG.
Arjun (Content): Draft copy (use short captions):
```
Headline: Redwood Inference — Benchmark: Fast, Affordable, Predictable
Stat 1: 85ms p95 latency (real app trace)
Stat 2: 42% lower per-token cost with batching + KV cache
Stat 3: 1.8x throughput at 95% utilization
CTA: Read the benchmark & join the webinar — link
```
Liam (Design): Nice. For the infographic we'll need a hierarchy: headline, three stats with icons, short explainer line, and small footer with methodology link. For the system diagram — want a simplified flow: request -> router -> model variants (fast/cost) -> cache -> client.
Nina (Brand): Brand notes: stick to primary palette, rounded corners, and use our approved icon set. No gradient backgrounds for benchmark assets. Use font Redwood-Display for headings, Redwood-UI for body. Hex check: primary #0055FF, accent #00C2A8, neutral #0F1720. Add alt text.
Maya (Marketing): Also please include an accessibility-friendly color contrast check and include alt text drafts for each asset. We need a version for dark bg slides.
Liam (Design): Will do. One question: do we want an explainer mini-diagram of routing policies (latency vs cost fallback)? Could be a small inset.
Arjun (Content): Yes — 2-line caption: "Smart routing balances latency and unit cost by selecting model variants and using KV cache fallbacks." Keep it non-technical.
Nina (Brand): Also add compliance checkbox: logo safe zone, no modified logo shapes, approved partner marks only. I'll attach the brand checklist link here: https://brand.redwood.example/checklist
Maya (Marketing): Priority order: 1) 1200x628 infographic for blog/social 2) 1600x900 hero slide + dark bg 3) 800x1000 one-pager PDF with methodology panel 4) small inset routing diagram SVG.
Liam (Design): ETA draft by Tue noon, final by Thu EOD. I'll post Figma file when draft is up: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/benchmark-assets
DesignBot: Uploaded: figma://file/EXAMPLE/benchmark-assets (thumbnail). Reaction :white_check_mark:.
Maya (Marketing): Great — acceptance criteria before ship: 1) matches copy and stats exactly, 2) color contrast AA, 3) SVGs optimized, 4) alt text included, 5) export variants provided.
Arjun (Content): I'll prepare short social captions and two variant CTAs: "Read the benchmark" and "Join the webinar".
Nina (Brand): Quick review call Wed 10am PT works for me.
Liam (Design): Wed 10am PT added. I'll post a short style frame in thread by Tue.
Maya (Marketing): Thanks all — tagging for visibility @Liam (Design) @Nina (Brand) @Arjun (Content) :rocket:
Liam (Design): On it.
note: The JSON fields are all strings or list of strings per agents.md schema.
